title: Co-Enrollment and Coding: Making Apprentices Count
description: Apprenticeship completions are recognized credentials and apprenticeship progress counts as Measurable Skill Gains, but only if staff enroll and code correctly. This course covers co-enrollment strategy, CalJOBS activity codes (300, 301, 428), PIRL element 931, type-of-training code 09, and how to capture outcomes over a multi-year apprenticeship.
notes: Audience: Case managers, MIS Administrators, data staff. Format: LV or SP. Hours assumed from format (LV/SP = 3 hours). Gap addressed: California's 2024 WIOA Annual Report publishes no apprenticeship co-enrollment figures; TEGL 05-25 sets a 10 percent sample goal.
learning_objectives: Identify when to co-enroll an apprentice in WIOA Title I and which program fits.
Select the correct activity codes and PIRL flags for apprenticeship-related services.
Record credential attainment and Measurable Skill Gains for apprentices.
Plan exit and follow-up timing for a participant in a multi-year program.

sequencing_rationale: Lessons follow the catalog's learning objectives in the order a practitioner meets them on the job: Co-Enrollment Strategy for Apprentices; Activity Codes and PIRL Flags; Credentials and Measurable Skill Gains; Exit and Follow-Up in a Multi-Year Program. There is no separate project lesson; each lesson ends in a practice exercise built on the same running case. Scope assumptions: hours are not stated in the source catalog and are assumed from the delivery format (LV or SP; LV/SP = 3 hours). Content is grounded in California and federal guidance named in the catalog description and objectives; the course cites those directives by number but does not reproduce their text, and every policy-specific claim must be checked against the current directive before delivery. Local board policy is treated as a variable the learner fills in from their own board, not something the course prescribes. Design driver (catalog "gap addressed"): California's 2024 WIOA Annual Report publishes no apprenticeship co-enrollment figures; TEGL 05-25 sets a 10 percent sample goal. Statistics and audit findings quoted from the catalog have not been independently verified. Prerequisites reflect track order: APP 101 (Registered Apprenticeship for Workforce Professionals); FND 101 (The Participant Journey) or equivalent.
